finding_text: Each container of a lot of raw materials was not tested to identify its contents with a specific, discriminating test. The sampling plan for raw materials was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 원료 로트의 각 용기에 대해 내용물을 확인하기 위한 특이적·식별적 시험(specific, discriminating test)을 실시하지 않았다. 원료에 대한 시료채취 계획(sampling plan)이 미흡했다.

finding_text: The traceability, legibility, documentation, formatting, and/or the accuracy of records was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 기록의 추적성(traceability), 가독성, 문서화, 서식 및/또는 정확성이 미흡했다.

finding_text: The sanitation programs were not adequately designed to identify and/or reduce the risks of contamination.
finding_text_ko: 위생관리 프로그램(sanitation program)이 오염 위험을 파악 및/또는 저감하도록 적절히 설계되지 않았다.

finding_text: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 전산화 시스템(computerized systems)을 포함한 장비의 교정(calibration), 점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The calibration, inspection, and/or qualification of the equipment, including computerized systems, was inadequate. The preventative maintenance and repair of the equipment was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 전산화 시스템(computerized systems)을 포함한 장비의 교정(calibration), 점검 및/또는 적격성평가(qualification)가 미흡했다. 장비의 예방정비(preventative maintenance)와 수리가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The segregation, rotation of stock, and/or the transportation of raw materials, packaging materials, intermediates, bulk drugs, and/or finished products was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 원료, 포장재, 중간제품, 벌크 의약품(bulk drugs) 및/또는 완제품의 구획·분리(segregation), 재고 선입선출(rotation of stock) 및/또는 운송이 미흡했다.

finding_text: The establishment and/or the maintenance of a data governance plan was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 데이터 거버넌스 계획(data governance plan)의 수립 및/또는 유지가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The investigation, handling, and/or reporting of test results that were out-of-specification was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 기준일탈(out-of-specification, OOS) 시험 결과에 대한 조사, 처리 및/또는 보고가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The education, experience, and/or oversight of the individual in charge of the quality control department was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 품질관리부서 책임자의 교육, 경력 및/또는 감독이 미흡했다.

finding_text: For operations requiring specialized containment, the measures in place were inadequate. The premises were not designed, constructed, operated, and/or maintained to prevent contamination.
finding_text_ko: 특수한 격리·봉쇄(containment)가 필요한 작업에 대해 마련된 조치가 미흡했다. 작업소(premises)가 오염을 방지하도록 설계, 시공, 운영 및/또는 유지관리되지 않았다.

finding_text: The implementation, effectiveness, and/or validation of the cleaning procedures was inadequate for preventing unsanitary conditions.
finding_text_ko: 세척 절차(cleaning procedures)의 실행, 유효성 및/또는 밸리데이션(validation)이 비위생적 상태를 방지하기에 미흡했다.

finding_text: Evaluation of production processes, equipment, and/or materials was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 제조공정, 장비 및/또는 자재에 대한 평가가 미흡했다.

finding_text: Investigations into deviations, reports, and/or follow-up actions were inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 일탈(deviation)에 대한 조사, 보고 및/또는 후속조치가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The written hygiene program was not being followed by plant personnel and/or visitors.
finding_text_ko: 문서화된 위생 프로그램(hygiene program)을 제조소 인원 및/또는 방문자가 준수하지 않았다.

finding_text: The availability, content and/or maintenance of the quality agreements between the supplier, fabricator, tester, packager, labeller, distributor, importer, and/or wholesaler was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 공급자, 제조자(fabricator), 시험자, 포장자, 표시자(labeller), 유통업자, 수입자 및/또는 도매상 간 품질계약서(quality agreement)의 구비, 내용 및/또는 유지관리가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The handling of standard operating procedures for good manufacturing practices was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: GMP(good manufacturing practices) 관련 표준작업절차서(SOP)의 관리가 미흡했다.

finding_text: The qualification and/or verification of utilities and/or support systems was inadequate.
finding_text_ko: 유틸리티(utilities) 및/또는 지원설비(support systems)의 적격성평가(qualification) 및/또는 검증(verification)이 미흡했다.
